CustomField.description: Calculate the Commission on basis of projects
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( Unit__r.Category__c = "MEGA MANSIONS", Unit__r.Category__c = "MANSIONS" ), /* Special rule for Mansions categories */ CASE(ProjectName__c, "Nawayef West", IF(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= DATE(2024, 11, 30), TotalAmount__c * 0.02, TotalAmount__c * 0.03), "Nawayef East", IF(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= DATE(2024, 11, 30), TotalAmount__c * 0.02, TotalAmount__c * 0.03), 0 ), /* Standard rule for other categories */ CASE(ProjectName__c, "Al Naseem", IF(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= DATE(2024, 11, 30), TotalAmount__c * 0.02, TotalAmount__c * 0.04), "Muheira", TotalAmount__c * 0.04, "Maysan", TotalAmount__c * 0.03, "Nawayef West", IF(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= DATE(2024, 11, 30), TotalAmount__c * 0.02, TotalAmount__c * 0.04), "Nawayef East", IF(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= DATE(2024, 11, 30), TotalAmount__c * 0.02, TotalAmount__c * 0.04), "Nawayef Park View", TotalAmount__c * 0.03, "Nawayef Village Townhouses", TotalAmount__c * 0.04, 0 ) )
CustomField.label: Total Commission (Based On SO Creation)
